card.name: Just before attack or episode words
card.fires_on: The end of the abbreviation HAE (the AE piece) and small words like "an" or "acute" right before a word like attack, flare or episode. It fires where the next word is likely to be an attack or episode.

modes.label: HAE before attack
modes.description: The AE piece of HAE, followed by the word attack in dosing instructions.
modes.example: at the earliest recognition of an H<<AE>> attack.

modes.label: Gout flare lead-in
modes.description: "an" or "acute" right before flare or gouty attack in gout text.
modes.example: Uric acid fluctuations in patients with gout may precipitate<< an>> acute flare.

card.writes: It promotes attack and episode words and suppresses water and fire words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say attack, flare or episode of a condition.
